annotations.title: Create or update a table of contents

description: Generate a table of contents (Inhaltsverzeichnis) from a TOC style (list_toc_styles, define_toc_style) into a new text frame on page_id – at position_mm (InDesign sizes the frame up to the margins) or exactly at bounds_mm. replace true updates the existing table of contents in its frame (after text or page changes) – page numbers are not live, so run it again after every change. include_overset also lists headings in overset text. Returns story_id, frame_id, frame_ids, page_id, page_name, page_ids, page_names, bounds_mm (of the first frame, relative to its page), paragraph_count, length, overset, replaced and lines[] {text, paragraph_style} (first 500 paragraphs; lines_truncated). Plus toc_style and entry_count (non-empty paragraphs except the title; null when lines_truncated). Warnings: no entries (no paragraph uses the styles), overset (enlarge or thread the frame), a second table of contents. The view of the layout window stays (keep_view, default true). Text placed with place_text_file brings no table of contents from Word – build it here.

bounds_mm.description: Exact position and size in mm on page_id, set after InDesign created the frame (overrides position_mm).

x.description: Left edge in mm; negative allowed for bleed (Anschnitt).

y.description: Top edge in mm; negative allowed.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

include_overset.description: Also read text in overset (Übersatz). Default false.

keep_view.description: Keep the layout window on its page (default true).

layer_name.description: Layer (Ebene) for the new frame, exact name from list_layers. Default: the active layer.

page_id.description: Document page that gets the new frame (from list_pages). Required unless replace.

position_mm.description: Top left corner of the new frame on page_id; InDesign chooses width and height. Default: top left margin corner.

x.description: Left edge in mm from the page.

y.description: Top edge in mm from the page.

replace.description: Update the existing one in its frame instead of creating another (default false). Without an existing one a new one is created (warning).

name: create_toc
title: Create or update a table of contents
